title: AIIMS CRE 5th Group B, C Admit Card 2026
organization: All India Institute of Medical Sciences
postName: Common Recruitment Examination (CRE-5) – Group B & C
vacancyDetails: About 1484 Group B & C posts through AIIMS CRE-5 CBT
qualification: Post-wise as per AIIMS CRE-5 notification (Group B & C)
ageLimit: Generally 18 to 30 years (post-wise variations as per notification)
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (CBT) → Document Verification / further stages
documentsRequired: Enrollment/Registration number; printed admit card; original photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in
2. Open CRE-5 Admit Card download link
3. Login with credentials
4. Download hall ticket for allotted shift (25-27 July)
5. Check centre change notices if any
shortDescription: AIIMS CRE-5 Group B & C Admit Card 2026 released on 21 July for CBT on 25-27 July 2026. Download from aiimsexams.ac.in.
content:
AIIMS has released the CRE-5 Admit Card 2026 on 21 July 2026 for Common Recruitment Examination covering Group B & C posts.

CBT dates: 25 to 27 July 2026 (two shifts). Application was open around 6 Jun – 3 Jul 2026.

  • Approx. posts: 1,484
  • Check centre change notices on aiimsexams.ac.in
  • Carry admit card and original photo ID
